source_label: Sample release scenario (config/workflow_stages.json): illustrative stage progress, not live workflow state. Live Cloud Build and Cloud Deploy status for S5 and S6 comes from GET /api/pipeline.

mode_descriptions.agentic: Agents plan and execute; deterministic exit gates check the evidence before the stage can close.
mode_descriptions.deterministic: Scripts run fixed commands with no agent judgment; a failed check bounces the release to the stage that owns the fix.

stages.title: Spec
stages.summary: Turn the request into SPEC.md with numbered, testable acceptance criteria linked to an outcome and goal.
entry_gates: Request is linked to an Outcome and Goal in the task backend
No open S1 task exists for the same goal
exit_gates: SPEC.md lists numbered acceptance criteria (AC-01 to AC-NN) and a test plan
core-coordinator approval is captured as a signed receipt (human gate)

stages.title: Tests
stages.summary: Write the test suite before the build: happy-path, edge-case, and chaos tests mapped to each acceptance criterion.
entry_gates: S1 exit receipt verifies PASS (spec approved by a human)
exit_gates: Every acceptance criterion in SPEC.md names tests that exist (checked by tests/test_honesty.py)
Tests cover happy paths, edge cases, and chaos (fail-closed) behavior
evidence: Test modules under tests/ with their commit SHA

stages.title: Build
stages.summary: Builders implement the spec in disjoint file leases until every test passes.
entry_gates: Each builder holds a disjoint file lease
exit_gates: pytest passes 100% (happy, edge, chaos)
No source file exceeds 400 lines
AST zero-hardcoding gate is green
Builders report done with commit SHAs

stages.title: Verify and QA
stages.summary: Independent verification: a three-model QA council, a dual-viewport browser sweep, and a security audit. No reviewer verifies their own code.
entry_gates: S3 exit receipt verifies PASS at the same commit
No QA agent is a builder of the change
exit_gates: 3 of 3 council approvals (gemini, opus, fable) with no open blocking findings
Playwright sweep at 1440x900 and 390x844: 0 console errors, 0 anomaly strings, no horizontal overflow
Security audit by core-iap-security: IAP only, no committed secrets, DP-001 guard active
evidence: Council review notes and decision receipt

stages.title: Release gate
stages.summary: A fixed script runs Cloud Build CI on the release commit and writes the immutable @sha256 release packet.
entry_gates: S4 council decision is 3 of 3 PASS at the release commit
Tracked files are clean at the release commit
exit_gates: Cloud Build is SUCCESS: guard-substitutions, unit-tests, docker-build, container-smoke, docker-push, release-packet
Release packet pins the commit and the image @sha256 digest
DP-001 guard policy is active and its shadow replay gate is PASS
Audit receipt chain verifies PASS (POST /api/receipts/verify)
Human release approval is captured as a signed receipt
evidence: Cloud Build build id and step results

stages.title: Deploy and close
stages.summary: A fixed script creates a Google Cloud Deploy release from the packet, probes IAP, and rolls back on failure.
entry_gates: S5 release packet pins the commit and the image @sha256 digest
Human release approval receipt verifies PASS
WORKFLOW_STAGE=S6_DEPLOY_CLOSE is set for the guard
exit_gates: Cloud Deploy rollout to osprey-core-prod SUCCEEDED and the new revision serves 100% of traffic
Unauthenticated GET returns 302 or 401; IAP-authenticated GET returns 200
GET /api/pipeline provenance matches the packet and the deploy report
IAP, ingress all, min and max 1 instance, the runtime service account, and the osprey-onboard-sa bindings are preserved
